mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a weakening demand environment that triggers equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), labor market weakness signals reduced consumer spending power and corporate profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates supply chain disruption and reduced economic activity, depressing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5% and remains above this level for three consecutive months, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90.0 and remains below this level for two consecutive months, it signals a significant supply shock that reduces economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.
